task: Remove the duplicated reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke entry from validate.commands in lattice.config.json so the smoke is invoked once per unfocused lattice validate run.
outcome: lattice.config.json lists the smoke exactly once (the focus-tagged object), the validate --json invocation record shows exactly one command result for that script, and validate --focus=fast still selects it.
facts: validate.commands has 48 entries; index 4 is the bare string 'node packages/main/dist/tasks/reviewer-scan-budget-guard-smoke.js' and index 12 is {command:node, args:[same script], focus:[fast]}.

commandFromString in packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts sets shell:true only when SHELL_META_RE (/[;&|<>$()`]/) matches; 'node <path>.js' does not match, so the bare string is split into the same command and args as the object form.
Neither entry declares cwd, env, timeoutMs or optional, so both share one execution identity apart from the focus tag.
filterFocusedConfiguredCommands (verifier.ts:184) keeps only commands whose focus array includes the requested focus; an unfocused run uses the full configuredCommands list.
A strict full-identity scan of all 48 entries found exactly one same-script pair (indexes 4 and 12) and no other duplicates.
The duplication pre-dates B-4043: both merge parents b8e28971d0^ and e436eb5447 already contain both entries.
constraints: Only lattice.config.json may change; the smoke script and the validate runner implementation stay untouched.
Arguments, timeout, execution context and fail-closed behaviour of the surviving entry must be preserved exactly.
Entries that share the script path but carry meaningfully different execution parameters must not be removed.
Exactly-once must be proven from the runner invocation record, not from a green exit code alone.
